nodes.summary: Let $\mathfrak m_1$ and $\mathfrak m_2$ be moduli of a number field $K$ with $\mathfrak m_2 \mid \mathfrak m_1$, and let $C_1$ be a congruence subgroup for $\mathfrak m_1$. Viewed as subgroups of the group of nonzero fractional ideals of $K$, the change of modulus of $C_1$ to $\mathfrak m_2$ equals the subgroup generated by $C_1$ and the ray group $P_{\mathfrak m_2}$ of $\mathfrak m_2$.

nodes.title: Change of modulus of a congruence subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. A congruence subgroup pair for $K$ consists of a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of $K$ together with a congruence subgroup for $\mathfrak m$, that is, a subgroup of the group of invertible fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$ that contains the ray group of $\mathfrak m$.
nodes.title: Congruence subgroup pair

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field and $\mathfrak m$ a modulus of $K$. A congruence subgroup for $\mathfrak m$ is a subgroup $H$ of the group of invertible fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$ such that $H$ contains the ray group of $\mathfrak m$.
nodes.title: Congruence subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $\mathfrak m_1$ and $\mathfrak m_2$ be moduli of a number field $K$ with $\mathfrak m_2 \mid \mathfrak m_1$. Then every nonzero fractional ideal of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m_1$ is coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m_2$.

nodes.title: Criterion for an equivalent congruence subgroup at a divisor of the modulus

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a congruence subgroup for a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$, and let $\pi$ be the canonical projection from the group of invertible fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$ onto the ray class group of $\mathfrak m$. The image of $H$ is the subgroup $\pi(H)$ of the ray class group.
nodes.title: Image of a congruence subgroup in the ray class group

Two pairs $(\mathfrak m, H)$ and $(\mathfrak n, H')$, each consisting of a modulus of $K$ and a congruence subgroup for it, are equivalent if and only if $I^{\mathfrak m} \cap H' = I^{\mathfrak n} \cap H$ in the group of all nonzero…
nodes.title: Criterion for equivalence of congruence subgroup pairs

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. For a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of $K$, write $I^{\mathfrak m}$ for the group of nonzero fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$. Two pairs $(\mathfrak m, H)$ and $(\mathfrak n, H')$, each consisting of a modulus of $K$ and a congruence subgroup for it, are equivalent when $I^{\mathfrak m} \cap H' = I^{\mathfrak n} \cap H$, where both congruence subgroups are…
nodes.title: Equivalence of congruence subgroup pairs

nodes.summary: For a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$, the largest congruence subgroup for $\mathfrak m$ is the whole group of invertible fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$, which contains the ray group of $\mathfrak m$.
nodes.title: Largest congruence subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a congruence subgroup for a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$, and let $\pi$ be the canonical projection from the group of invertible fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$ onto the ray class group of $\mathfrak m$. An element $x$ of the ray class group lies in the image $\pi(H)$ if and only if $\pi(y) = x$ for some $y \in H$.
nodes.title: Membership in the image of a congruence subgroup

nodes.summary: For every modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$, the ray group of $\mathfrak m$, viewed as a subgroup of the group of nonzero fractional ideals of $K$, is contained in the group of nonzero fractional ideals coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$.
nodes.title: The ray group consists of coprime ideals

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a congruence subgroup for a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$. Viewed as subgroups of the group of nonzero fractional ideals of $K$, the ray group of $\mathfrak m$ is contained in $C$.
nodes.title: A congruence subgroup contains the ray group

nodes.summary: For a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$, the ambient ray group of $\mathfrak m$ is the image of the ray group of $\mathfrak m$ under the inclusion of the group of nonzero fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$ into the group of all nonzero fractional ideals of $K$.
nodes.title: Ray group among all fractional ideals

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. Every pair consisting of a modulus of $K$ and a congruence subgroup for it is equivalent to itself.
nodes.title: Equivalence of congruence subgroup pairs is reflexive

nodes.summary: For a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$, the smallest congruence subgroup for $\mathfrak m$ is the ray group of $\mathfrak m$ itself, a subgroup of the group of invertible fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$.
nodes.title: Smallest congruence subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field. If a pair $P$, consisting of a modulus of $K$ and a congruence subgroup for it, is equivalent to such a pair $Q$, then $Q$ is equivalent to $P$.
nodes.title: Equivalence of congruence subgroup pairs is symmetric

nodes.summary: For a congruence subgroup $H$ for a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$, this is the image of $H$ under the inclusion of the group of invertible fractional ideals of $K$ coprime to the finite part of $\mathfrak m$ into the group of all invertible fractional ideals of $K$.
nodes.title: Congruence subgroup as a subgroup of all invertible fractional ideals

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
